notes.title: Next game – Dark Train: Coupe – is on Greenlight!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.paperash.com/wp-content/greenlight2/banner.jpg[/img]

Dear passengers,

We are thrilled to announce that our next game Dark Train: Coupe is right now “fighting” for your votes on Steam Greenlight. 

You can support it by voting YES here: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=917024772

Beware! Dark Train: Coupe is a standalone game that is closely related to the original Dark Train (2016) in lore but NOT in GAMEPLAY. We do love to take risks and experiment. 

Therfore the Dark Train: Coupe is a text based non-linear game witch rich dialogue and mysterious (papercut) visuals that explores the stories of Ann Tagrezbung - main protagonist in Dark Train (2016). Both games are located in the same place - The Border City - but in different time.

TRAILER
https://youtu.be/adE1zhHl2lk


[img]http://www.paperash.com/wp-content/greenlight2/dtc.png[/img]
[img]http://www.paperash.com/wp-content/greenlight2/dtc2.png[/img]

As the name of our second game suggest, Dark Train: Coupe (DTC) is closely related to its predecessor [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/532290/]Dark Train (2016) - logical atmospheric adventure[/url] in which the story is conveyed without use of any words. DTC is the other extreme. Its story is narrated mainly with words and sentences. You can argue that it is more of a digital gamebook and/or sophisticated visual novel rather then skill based logical adventure as Dark Train was. And you would be right.

[img]http://www.paperash.com/wp-content/greenlight/dt_n3.png[/img]
But both games have many things in common, especially the fictional Dark Train world itself. Main story arc is played in the passenger train on the same railroad and you will not venture forth. Both stories are therefore located in the same place - The Border City - but in different time. You will also meet main protagonist Ann Tagrezbung from the first game. We must warn you, she is quite lovely, unmechanical and still human...

[img]http://www.paperash.com/wp-content/greenlight2/2.gif[/img]

[img]http://www.paperash.com/wp-content/greenlight/dt_n2.png[/img]
We decided to tell a story of Dark Train (2016) purely without any text just with atmosphere, symbolism and non-textual narrative tools. It was a design challenge for sure, but we persisted and the game was critically acclaimed for its atmosphere, enigmatic nature and its unique visuals (DT won Czech Game Award 2016). Now, our design intention is completely different.

When you begin your journey, there is no way to turn back or stop the train. Travel through the city, learn about the Dark Train world, explore the mythology of The Border City and the ways of existence of its people.

All of that within one mysterious train coupe...

[img]http://www.paperash.com/wp-content/greenlight/dt_n4.png[/img][list][*]rich dialogues [*]decision based story progression
 [*]tons of text and reading
 [*]you will suffer by reading
 [*]non-reading gameplay doesn’t exist here… well maybe a little…
 [*]standalone game (no DLC, no datadisk)
[/list]

[img]http://www.paperash.com/wp-content/greenlight2/1.gif[/img]

[img]http://www.paperash.com/wp-content/greenlight/dt_n6.png[/img]
[img]http://www.paperash.com/wp-content/greenlight2/achiev.png[/img]

[img]http://www.paperash.com/wp-content/greenlight/dt_n7.png[/img]

[h1]Is Dark Train: Coupe a standalone game?[/h1]
YES

[h1]Do I need to finish Dark Train (2016) first to enjoy Dark Train: Coupe?[/h1]
NO

[h1]What are the key game mechanics?[/h1]
Everything comes down to the dialogue. The key game mechanic is a dialogue choice. Of course by carefully choosing answers and questions you will soon discover there is a lot of hidden story arcs that can be experienced only in certain situations. Even though it is a simple game mechanic, it doesn’t constrain us in designing broader gameplay systems (collecting, exploring, replayability, achievements, easter eggs, timing, risk vs reward decisions…).

[h1]Are Dark Train (2016) and Dark Train: Coupe (Q4 2017) simmilar games?[/h1]
Not in gameplay, YES in lore.

[img]http://www.paperash.com/wp-content/greenlight2/3.gif[/img]
[h1]More info[/h1]
http://www.paperash.com

notes.title: DARK TRAIN – DEEP INTO THE CITY 2 (UPDATE)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26615398/98dfbfd2219f7b2dbf0be646b6bac3009f4c22cc.jpg[/img]

Dear passengers, spring has come and Dark Train's journey is now lined by new levels! 

[b]TRAILER:[/b]
https://youtu.be/cx_wYlW6KUc
[b]FIRST![/b]
Frozen to the metal event rooms and places are still accessible, but there is nothing you can do until next winter. Some of achived souvenirs like “damask knife” or “golden pig” remain in engine room until the game is completed.

[b]IMPORTANT![/b] 
From now steam whistle “trumpet” can be mounted to the main DT chimney (just let Ann play's the Organ for awhile). So we can really talk about a train now!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26615398/72966d761373268e227274257b05c156130f7398.jpg[/img]

[b]RUMMORS:[/b]
Chimney sweepers guild attached a mechanical “splitter” outside one of the factories. “The splitter” could temporarily release Ann from her bound. Now there is no doubt that Ann becomes their important ally.

[b]FIX:[/b]
Outdoor events (windows + periscope) can no longer be repeated. Once the plot is finished and the train get rewarded event is definately done.

Thank you for your support!
Paperash

notes.title: DARK TRAIN demo is now available!
notes.content:
store.steampowered.com/app/605660

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26615398/ff08cf5ef3284ab920510d101b88c9e8c2ca38f3.jpg[/img]

Are you curious about what it's like to be a disobedient squid ANN 2.35f with four tentacles controlling a whole train? Ridiculous? No, try demo version of Dark Train!

[b]DARK TRAIN is a 2D atmospheric hardcore adventure [/b] (no hints, no text, no help!) in an oppressive setting full of handmade papercut visuals, logical puzzles and mysteries about famous inventor D. W. Tagrezbung. As a player your task is simple. Leave the gates of Border City.


DARK TRAIN FEATURES:
[list]
    [*]story - strong narrative with direct action gameplay
    [*]exploration - non-casual exploratory game feel
    [*]atmosphere - dark oppressive setting
    [*]narration - non-textual, situational
    [*]audiovisuals - paper-art style
    [*]no hints, no help - there is always a way to solve it
[/list]

[spoiler]PS: In Steam demo version the new achievement is hidden!   

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26615398/da6a396ccba1a21c9eecaa9f400d0ba4aa391cf5.jpg[/img][/spoiler]
